title: 海龟怎么找回出生的那片海滩
subtitle: 它记得沙子的味道
character: wearing a light blue t-shirt, sand coloured shorts and bare feet, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft pastel drawing with powdery blended strokes and visible tooth of the surface, sea blue, warm sand and coral orange

pages.zh:
海边的沙子很烫。
退潮的地方
有一道浅浅的印子，
从水里一直爬上来。
爸爸说是海龟爬的。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up standing on a beach at low tide, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, pointing down at a track in the sand.

pages.zh:
夏天的半夜，
一只母海龟上了岸。
它在水里很轻快，
到了沙滩上
只能一点一点往前挪。
pages.scene: One large sea turtle hauling itself slowly up a beach at night on a cream background, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它用后脚挖坑，
挖得比自己还深。
然后把蛋下进去，
一百多个，
再把沙子盖回来。

蛋埋在沙子里，
靠太阳的热气孵。
沙子凉的时候，
孵出来多是男孩；
热的时候多是女孩。

两个月以后，
蛋壳里传出响动。
小海龟用嘴上的
一个小尖，
把壳顶开一道缝。
pages.scene: One baby sea turtle breaking out of a white egg on a cream background, a crack opening along the shell. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它们等到天黑才出来。
一窝几十只，
一起往海的方向爬。
谁也不回头，
谁也不停下。
pages.scene: Many baby sea turtles on a cream background seen from above, all crawling in the same direction. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
就在爬这几分钟里，
它们把这片沙滩
记了下来。
记的不是样子，
是地下磁力的方向。

地球本身是块大磁铁。
每一段海岸，
磁力的劲儿都不一样。
小海龟记住的，
就是这里的那一份。

然后它们游走了。
游进大洋，
一游就是好多年，
绕着地球转半圈，
谁也不知道它在哪。
pages.scene: One sea turtle swimming alone in open water on a cream background, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有的海龟游过的路，
加起来上万公里，
比从我们家
走到南极还要远。
它一路都没有地图。

二十年后，
它长成了大海龟，
又回到这片沙滩。
不是旁边那一片，
就是它出生的这一片。
pages.scene: One large sea turtle coming out of the water onto sand on a cream background, seen from the side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我在沙滩上走，
沙子是一样的沙子。
可海龟分得出来。
它记住的不是路，
是这一片沙的味道。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up sitting on the sand with a handful of it running through his fingers, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, quiet.
